light_description: Chinese GIGAGAIN transparent booster with warm/standard voicing and a separate signal-level indicator; retained as dirt-adjacent rather than central dirt.
Chinese low-gain overdrive positioned between a booster and classic overdrive, with HOT switching and FAT low-frequency shaping.
Chinese player-focused drive product from GIGAGAIN's first-generation effects range, documented alongside the core gain catalog.
Chinese TS-style overdrive with switchable 808/9 voicing plus BB and Scoop tone-shaping modes.
Chinese analog Marshall-style distortion with Vintage and Modern voicing modes.
Chinese analog Dumble-style overdrive with selectable ODS and SSS voicings.
